note: These normalized values are gameplay abstractions, not canonical Star Trek equations.
filter_rules: A specific filter excludes signatures of other types.
The 'all' filter evaluates every signature without a specific-filter bonus.
A matching specific filter improves detection.
A matching priority improves detection without excluding other selected filters.
hidden_property_rules: The contact must reach resolved state.
If preferred_filter exists it must be explicitly selected or used as priority.
Unmet hidden properties are omitted from the observation instead of being returned as null/false.
anti_leakage_rules: Player observation does not expose authoritative entity_id.
Unobserved entities are omitted from player detections.
Unrevealed hidden ground-truth values are never copied into result payloads.
